note: Synthetic responses for the packaged Dropbox profile. Field names come from the official API specification repository; every value is synthetic, no credential appears here, and nothing has been sent to a live account.

authentication.documented_route_auth: The account route is declared auth = user, so app credentials are not accepted.

/2/files/list_folder.401: AuthError, with the error field in the body
/2/files/list_folder.429: RateLimitError, with a retry-after header or retry_after field

/2/files/list_folder/continue.409: reset, documented as an invalid or expired cursor, which means list_folder must be called again for a new cursor

/2/users/get_current_account.401: AuthError, with the error field in the body

engine_bounds: The engine bounds a reviewed string input to 512 characters, so the path input is capped at 512 even though Dropbox documents longer paths.
list_folder limit is bounded to the documented 1–2000 range, and pages are capped at the engine maximum of three.
The documented error body shape is unverified: error_summary appears in no readable official source.

The engine refuses a path-like destination, so read_metadata cannot ship: Dropbox documents get_metadata by path and offers no id-keyed metadata route, so a single item read waits for a reviewed id destination rule.
notes: list_folder/continue takes only the returned cursor, and returns the same entries, cursor and has_more fields.
email is documented as unreliable without email_verified, so the account label is name.display_name and never email.
profile_photo_url is documented as nullable and country is absent from the plain account variant, so neither is projected.
